notes: 26.9.7 (npm 3110.7.0) with --provider=litellm: user-agent 'junie-cli-batch:<version>', LiteLLM client headers (LiteLLM-Disable-Message-Redaction, x-litellm-num-retries, x-litellm-tags), 'Openai-Version: 2020-11-07'; never streams, n 1, seed 100000, stop ['</COMMAND>'], reasoning_effort high, user 'primary'. The system prompt opens with '## ENVIRONMENT' and names the model; the identity clause follows within the first 200 characters. Each run also sends a task-description summariser and a step summariser request (no tools), covered by the second identity feature. Junie rejects a plain text answer ('missing a tool call') and nudges until a tool or submit is called; the follow-up (--resume --session-id) arrives as <issue_update>. The model name must be one of Junie's built-ins and must appear in GET /v1/model/info.
